quests.title: Big Badaboom Battle

dialogue.t: Looks like this was left by Albedo... whoa, this looks like one fierce fella.
Is this Albedo's latest work? If you look closely, it does look similar to the gift that Alice left for Klee.
C'mon, Traveler, find some way to take care of it!

quests.description: Paimon is very curious about Albedo…
